title: Confraternity
summary: CONFRATERNITY, noun [Latin , fraternity, brother.] A brotherhood; a society or body of men, united for some purpose or in some profession; as the confraternity of Jesuits.

inlines.v: CONFRATERNITY, noun [Latin , fraternity, brother.] A brotherhood; a society or body of men, united for some purpose or in some profession; as the confraternity of Jesuits.
